QuestInfo.name: The Dangerous Android
QuestInfo.1: You ran into Bao when you were searching the city center area at the request of May. Bao asked for your help because he can't really do much with the Iruvatas roaming around. He seems to be quite scared. Eliminate #r50 Iruvatas#k for Bao.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Iruvata for Bao, a young man terrified of Iruvata. The gigantic Bao appreciated your help so much that he bowed at your feet. The poor boy is too timid....
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 508,102
The Wreckage of the Missile now available
Can proceed to It's Not Safe Yet quest
QuestInfo.0: You ran into #p2082010# while you were searching for survivors for #p2082009#.

0.0: Be quiet! Iruvatas are all over the place. They're androids designed to look like female warriors. They are very, very dangerous. Say...you look pretty tough yourself. Do you think you could take a couple of them on?

yes.0: Y-you're really brave! I'll leave the #rIruvatas#k to you! Thank you so much.

no.0: I know. Anyone would be scared. They are, like I said, extremely dangerous.

1.0: I was cheering for you from here. That was incredible! But first things first. Am I the only survivor?\r\n#b#L0#There is a lady named May not too far from here.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh... Really? Then I should suck it up and go over there. Thank you so much for your help.
